authority: Focused System.Reflection.Metadata plus System.Reflection.Emit OpCodes from the host framework; no vendor assembly loading/execution

manifest.scope: GlobalScript candidate COM contract and selected single-run managed call chain; no vendor execution.

operand.value: StartOnce is time out, waite for compile end

limitations: Metadata tokens are bound to the recorded artifact SHA-256/MVID.
CIL decoding and direct method token references do not prove original BAML/resource identity, connectionId branch activation or runtime event execution.
MemberRef types/signatures and MethodSpec target plus raw instantiation signature are metadata, not semantic generic substitution or runtime binding.
